instruction.text: What type of animal are these? Select the correct word.

feedback.correct: All of these animals are reptiles. Reptiles are cold-blooded, their skin is covered with scales, and most reptiles lay eggs.

instruction.text: Match the text with the correct stage.

hint.text: The life cycle of a reptile begins inside an egg.

atoms.b: Most reptiles develop in an egg, where they stay until ready to hatch.
The little reptiles hatch from the eggs. In comparison to many other animals, reptiles are quickly abandoned by their parents and start life on their own.
Most of a reptile’s maturing happens during the juvenile stage.
atoms.sound: Most of a reptile’s maturing happens during the juvenile stage.

atoms.b: The last stage begins once the reptile has reached their full size. The adult reptile can lay eggs and the life cycle begins again.

instruction.text: Is this image of a turtle’s life cycle correct? The cycle begins with the photo on top. Select the correct answer.

hint.text: Reptiles are cold-blooded, their skin is covered with scales, and most reptiles lay eggs.

instruction.text: Look at the pictures. Which animal is part of the reptile species?

feedback.correct: The crocodile is a reptile. Let’s look at the crocodile’s life cycle.

instruction.text: Match the photo with the correct stage of the crocodile’s life cycle.
True or false? Select the correct answers about the life cycles of reptiles.

atoms.a: A reptile’s life cycle starts inside an egg.
Baby reptiles live most of their life with their parents.
Turtles and crocodiles have a very similar life cycle.
